title: Moong Dal Halwa
description: A rich, fragrant halwa of slow-roasted yellow moong dal, ghee and milk — a winter wedding and festival special.
steps: Drain the soaked dal and grind it coarsely with a splash of water.
Heat the ghee in a heavy pan and add the dal paste; roast on low heat, stirring constantly, for 20 to 25 minutes until it turns golden brown and releases ghee.
Warm the milk, water and sugar together until the sugar dissolves.
Add the hot milk mixture carefully to the roasted dal; it will bubble and splutter.
Cook on low heat, stirring, until the liquid is absorbed and the halwa leaves the pan.
Stir in the cardamom and garnish with the almonds.
